# Security policy

**Do not open a public issue, pull request or discussion for a security problem.**

To report a vulnerability, use GitHub's private reporting: open the
[Security tab](https://github.com/BadTonho/SparkBrowser/security) and choose
**Report a vulnerability**. We aim to acknowledge reports within 7 days.

Security fixes are made for the latest release and the `main` branch.

The full policy covers what to include, scope, supported versions and good-faith research:

- [Security policy (English)](../docs/en/security/reporting-vulnerabilities.md)
- [Política de segurança (Português)](../docs/pt-BR/security/reporting-vulnerabilities.md)
